description: One streamed Gemini answer with a reasoning part, traced by the official OTel Google GenAI instrumentation.
notes: Content is requested on spans: OTEL_SEMCONV_STABILITY_OPT_IN=gen_ai_latest_experimental and OTEL_INSTRUMENTATION_GENAI_CAPTURE_MESSAGE_CONTENT=span_only. GoogleGenAiSdkInstrumentor sets OTEL_INSTRUMENTATION_GENAI_EMIT_EVENT=true while instrumenting generate_content; this span has no events. The mock waits 120 ms before the first chunk and splits reasoning and text into 4 chunks each. gen_ai.response.time_to_first_chunk is set. The instrumentor adds thoughtsTokenCount 6 to candidatesTokenCount 14 and writes gen_ai.usage.output_tokens 20, plus gen_ai.usage.reasoning.output_tokens 6. Output messages are one text part per chunk, and the reasoning text is not marked as a thought. prices.json has no Gemini model row.
